tools.name: get_setup_url
tools.description: Return the loopback-only page used to connect a NIP-07 browser extension or an advanced NIP-46 signer.

tools.name: get_signer_status
tools.description: Check whether a user-controlled NIP-07 or NIP-46 signer is connected.

tools.name: begin_nostrconnect_pairing
tools.description: Advanced fallback: create a nostrconnect:// URI for the user to scan or open in a remote signer. Never accepts an nsec.

tools.name: connect_bunker
tools.description: Connect a bunker:// URI only when the user knowingly supplied it. Prefer the local setup page so connection secrets are not placed in chat. Never accepts an nsec.

tools.name: get_public_key
tools.description: Return the public key exposed by the currently paired signer.

tools.name: prepare_note
tools.description: Prepare and bind an exact unsigned kind:1 note for user review. This does not sign or publish.

tools.name: prepare_event
tools.description: Validate and bind an exact unsigned Nostr event for user review. This does not sign or publish. Show the user every field before requesting a signature.

tools.name: sign_event
tools.description: Ask the paired signer to approve and sign the exact event bound to a fresh intent. Requires explicit user intent and never publishes.

tools.name: publish_event
tools.description: Publish a previously verified signed event to configured relays. Requires separate explicit user intent.

tools.name: nip44_encrypt
tools.description: Ask the paired signer to NIP-44 encrypt plaintext for a public key. Never logs plaintext; requires explicit user intent.

tools.name: nip44_decrypt
tools.description: Ask the paired signer to NIP-44 decrypt ciphertext. Returns sensitive plaintext only after explicit user intent.

tools.name: query_events
tools.description: Read a bounded set of verified public profile or note events from selected relays.

tools.name: disconnect_signer
tools.description: Forget the in-memory signer session and all prepared events.

tools.name: get_grynvault_account_dashboard
tools.description: Read the connected Nostr identity's Grynvault supporter, payment, and NIP-05 dashboard using a short-lived signed authorization. This does not create an invoice or change settlement.

tools.name: approve_grynvault_browser_handoff
tools.description: Sign a short-lived, read-only Grynvault account handoff code so the browser tab that created it can receive its own dashboard. This does not create an invoice, publish a Nostr event, change settlement, or grant wallet custody.

tools.name: prepare_grynvault_supporter_invoice
tools.description: Prepare an exact, short-lived signed-authorization request for a one-time donation of 21 to 1,000,000 sats or the fixed 2,100-sat 30-day membership. Does not sign, create, pay, or settle an invoice.

tools.name: create_grynvault_supporter_invoice
tools.description: After separate explicit user confirmation, sign the prepared authorization and create exactly one pending Grynvault supporter invoice. Does not pay it and never treats a redirect as settlement.

tools.name: prepare_grynvault_nip05_invoice
tools.description: Check and normalize a name@frontiercrown.com identifier, then prepare its exact 2,000-sat invoice authorization. Does not sign, reserve the name, create, pay, or settle an invoice.

tools.name: create_grynvault_nip05_invoice
tools.description: After separate explicit user confirmation, sign the prepared authorization and create exactly one pending 2,000-sat name@frontiercrown.com invoice. Does not pay, settle, activate, or prove identity.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_setup_url · Private data: connect_bunker, approve_grynvault_browser_handoff · Public sink: prepare_note, prepare_event, publish_event, approve_grynvault_browser_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_setup_url · Private data: connect_bunker, approve_grynvault_browser_handoff · Public sink: prepare_note, prepare_event, publish_event, approve_grynvault_browser_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
